review_policy: URLs verified live 2026-09-23. Rules state what applies to whom with official sources. Verify before quoting.

rules.detail: Instructors charging for car driving lessons must be registered as Approved Driving Instructors (ADIs), display their badge, and meet standards checks. Unregistered paid instruction is an offence.
rules.citation: Road Traffic Act 1988 Part V; DVSA ADI guidance
rules.owner_action: Register as ADI before taking paying pupils; display badge; maintain standards-check grade.
rules.escalation: DVSA for registration and standards queries.
rules.failure_mode: Prosecution for unregistered instruction; pupils uninsured.

rules.detail: Businesses transporting waste they produce (garden waste, trade refuse) need to check whether waste carrier registration applies to them. Registration tiers depend on waste type and role — check the live source.
rules.applies_when: Carrying trade waste (e.g. garden clearances) for disposal.
rules.owner_action: Check whether your waste type needs upper- or lower-tier registration; register before carrying.
rules.failure_mode: Fixed-penalty notices and prosecution for unregistered carrying.

rules.law: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health (COSHH)
rules.detail: Employers (and self-employed whose work affects others) must assess risks from hazardous substances — cleaning chemicals, solvents, detailing compounds — and control exposure. Includes safety data sheets, storage, and training.
rules.applies_when: Using chemical products beyond ordinary domestic use.
rules.owner_action: List products used, get safety data sheets, assess and record controls, train anyone exposed.
rules.escalation: HSE guidance or a safety consultant for complex assessments.
rules.failure_mode: Worker/customer harm; HSE enforcement on inspection or incident.

rules.detail: Organisations that process personal data (customer names, numbers, addresses, job records) must generally register with the ICO and pay an annual data protection fee. Exemptions are narrow — check the live self-assessment rather than assuming one applies.
rules.citation: Data Protection Act 2018; ICO fee guidance
rules.applies_when: Holding customer personal data for business purposes.
rules.owner_action: Complete the ICO self-assessment; register and pay the fee if required (typically tens of pounds per year).
